panels.title: Process CPU
panels.description: CPU seconds consumed per second, per service.

panels.title: Service restarts
panels.description: Cumulative restarts since boot. A climbing line is a crash loop.

panels.title: Committed vs used disk
panels.description: Thin provisioning means committed legitimately exceeds the pool; the gap between these two lines is the overcommit being relied on.

panels.title: Credit per customer
panels.description: Balance in Toman. A line crossing zero is a machine about to stop.

panels.title: Ledger movement by kind
panels.description: Toman per second by ledger kind. Negative is revenue.

panels.title: Authentication failures
panels.description: Reason, never which account - that would be an unbounded label and a log of who is being targeted.

panels.title: Provisioner p95 by verb
panels.description: Verbs are a fixed allowlist, which is what makes this label safe.

panels.title: Agent readiness
panels.description: How many workspaces have each managed agent actually installed.

panels.title: SMS outbox by status
panels.description: `skipped` is the temporary trial allowlist, not a failure.
